intro: Your work: renderings, graphics and the talk about them. New orders come to sales first. You see no price.
tiles: Go to a part of the page
failed: The design desk could not be read. Try again.

asked.title: Asked
asked.info: Orders and sent orders where help with the graphics is asked of you, the graphics were given to you, or you are on them.

why.GIVEN: the graphics were given to you

approvals.title: Waits for approval
approvals.info: The customer is asked to approve the design. The work goes on meanwhile.

codes.title: Scan codes
codes.info: Confirmed orders before the print: where the scan code sits on each design page. A page without a place gets the usual one (top right, 20 mm).
codes.notYet: The scan code places come with the print part. Nothing to place here yet.
codes.none: No confirmed order waits for the print.

floor.title: From the floor
floor.info: A worker asked you with one tap. Take it, do it, tell the worker.
floor.wordsHint: One line, if you want. The worker reads it on the basket.
